description: This Java class 'RuleChainEdgeProcessor' handles processing of rule chain related messages and events in an edge computing context within the Thingsboard platform. It manages creation, update, deletion, and conversion of rule chain data between internal representations and edge messages, including handling metadata and event conversion to downlink messages.

classes.name: RuleChainEdgeProcessor
classes.description: Handles processing of rule chain messages and events for edge synchronization, including creation, update, deletion, and conversion to downlink messages.

methods.name: processRuleChainMsgFromEdge
methods.description: Processes incoming rule chain messages from an edge, handling creation, update, or deletion based on message type.

methods.name: saveOrUpdateRuleChain
methods.description: Saves or updates a rule chain based on the received message, and manages relations and event pushing.

methods.name: pushRuleChainCreatedEventToRuleEngine
methods.description: Pushes a rule chain creation event to the rule engine.

methods.name: processRuleChainMetadataMsgFromEdge
methods.description: Processes rule chain metadata update messages from an edge.

methods.name: convertEdgeEventToDownlink
methods.description: Converts an edge event related to rule chains into a downlink message for the edge.

methods.name: getEdgeEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of edge event this processor handles, which is RULE_CHAIN.
